=====
Version 1.16-1.19-5.0

Now supports Japanese!

Adds colored flower pots for each of the 16 vanilla Minecraft colors.

Recipes:

Dye + Pot = Colored Pot
Colored Brick = '#'
			# #
			 #

=====
Version 1.20-5.0

Colored Bricks supports MC version 1.20.x now! 

Creative Menu Reorganization:
Brick Blocks -> Building Block Tab
Pots -> Functional Blocks Tab
Ingots -> Ingredients Tab

Pots now support torchflower and cherry sapling!
